items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He was a partner of Pops, and that's why they got Louis Williams from there...

ctx.x: Baby Lawrence... He run 'em all out. But he'd been with the Whitman Sisters, and they didn't believe in paying you, so he disappeared. That's how they come in (?). He was a partner of Pops, and that's why they got Louis Williams from there...
